title: One Vehicle, One Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
A host lists each vehicle separately, so one host may hold as many Keyturn Vehicle Listings as they have vehicles, subject only to the per-class ceiling each class sets. No ceiling is set on the number of listings a host may hold across the marketplace as a whole.

One vehicle is listed once and once only. A second listing raised on a vehicle already listed by the same host is a duplicate to be withdrawn rather than a second listing, and the last six characters of the vehicle identification number are what tell two otherwise identical vehicles apart.

Each listing carries its own class, its own price and its own inspection clock, and nothing about one listing moves another.

### The same rule, put as the questions it answers

*A host offers three cars.* Three Keyturn Vehicle Listings stand, one for each vehicle, each with its own class, price and inspection clock.

*Two of those cars are the same make, model, year and colour.* They are still two vehicles and two listings, told apart by the last six characters of the vehicle identification number.

*A host raises a second listing for a car they have already listed.* That second listing is a duplicate and is withdrawn; the standing listing is unaffected, because nothing about one listing moves another.
